title: Reference Engine Research Before Implementation
description: Before implementing any new system, launch architect agents in parallel to analyze how UE5 (W:\\UE_5.6_Source), Godot (E:\\godot), and Unity solve the same problem. Synthesize findings with engine-architect into UzEngine-specific directives. This prevents reinventing wheels and produces production-quality patterns. Architect agents run on haiku (cheap). Never rely solely on model knowledge — real engine source is ground truth.
example:
# Example: Implementing clustered shading
1. Launch unreal-architect: "How does UE5 implement clustered/tiled shading?"
2. Launch godot-architect: "How does Godot 4 handle light culling?"
3. Launch unity-architect: "How does Unity URP/HDRP handle light clustering?"
4. Launch engine-architect: Synthesize → UzEngine directive
5. Implement based on synthesized directive
whenToUse: Before any new feature/system implementation. Before debugging a hard problem (check reference engines for edge cases). When making architectural decisions that affect multiple subsystems.
whenNotToUse: For trivial bug fixes where the solution is obvious. For UzEngine-specific systems with no engine equivalent.
